analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 41.7 continues to consolidate in neutral territory, ADX at 23.9 enters early trend formation. MACD histogram worsening to -3.8508 indicates weakening buying pressure. Volume ratio of 0.89 over 5 days suggests lack of direction. SPY is down 8.1% from its 52-week high, diverging from the broader market's QQQ rally on Nov 23. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
